verdict.rationale: Retell documents official, typed SDKs for Node.js and Python with API-key auth, structured errors, full TypeScript autocomplete, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage. The API reference shows per-language SDK examples, and SDK breaking changes are tracked on a dated deprecation-notices page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and official SDKs beyond Node.js and Python.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Retell provides official SDKs for Node.js and Python to simplify integration with our platform.
Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
Type safety: Full TypeScript support with autocomplete
